title: The BEST meal planning app!!
body: This is the absolute best meal planning app for busy moms!! It has hundreds of delicious recipes that you can search by meal type or cooking method. It makes a super convenient shopping list for you based on your meal plan. You can even add your own recipes. Absolutely love it and everything from Six Sisters Stuff.

title: Everything I need in one place
body: I’ve always loved the Six Sisters recipes and now it’s even easier to find what we love! Being able to get our ingredients automatically and being able to shop within the app is a game changer!
